senses.gloss: पृच् (I) vi. 2Ā (pp. पृक्ण; pres. पृक्ते) To come in contact with.

पृच् (II) vt. 7P (pp. पृक्त; pres. पृणक्ति) 1. To bring into contact, to unite, to join, अपृणग्धनुषा शरम् Rt.vi.39; 2. to satisfy, to satiate; 3. to increase, to augment.With सम्-, to bring in contact with, to mix, to unite.
पृच् (III) vt. or vi. 1P, 10U (pres. पर्चति, पर्चयति-ते) 1. To hinder; 2. to come in contact with.
पृच्छक m. An inquirer, an investigator.
पृच्छा f. 1. Questioning, inquiring; 2. an inquiry into the future.
